subject.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: Should Matrix overflow polls be silently truncated to 20 answers at the builder boundary, rejected with a clear error, or retain current passthrough until an owner-approved interoperability policy exists?
rationale: The 20-option ecosystem target is supported, but choosing whether OpenClaw silently drops supplied answers is a user-visible channel contract rather than a mechanical protocol correction.

options.title: Adopt builder truncation
options.body: Accept the proposed first-20 behavior as the Matrix channel contract and require real homeserver proof before merging.

options.title: Reject oversized polls
options.body: Require an explicit Matrix-boundary validation error so callers know that their requested answers were not sent.

options.title: Defer enforcement
options.body: Leave existing behavior unchanged until a Matrix owner confirms the appropriate interoperability policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt builder truncation
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed first-20 behavior as the Matrix channel contract and require real homeserver proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision hinges on the MSC3381 poll interoperability contract rather than shared OpenClaw normalization behavior.
